fields.value: Score each checkpoint against the one of its line at a fraction of its position

Requested by Jack Heart for MTG-183, 2026-10-27: a curve of each checkpoint against the checkpoint at half its updates (6,000 v 3,000, 3,000 v 1,500, 800 v 400, 400 v 200, 200 v 100), to see over time what doubling training buys.

Etude 0.2.9 has Curve(opponent=Earlier(clock, by)) (an exact offset) and At(clock, value), but nothing relative to the point's own position. Wanted: an opponent such as Earlier(clock="updates", fraction=0.5), or a separate record, whose opponent is the checkpoint of the same line standing at fraction × the point's position on the clock. Same exactness rule as Earlier: no checkpoint exactly there is a gap that says so (MTG-183's design plays exact halves only; its endpoint 5,950 has no exact half). A log-scale x axis would suit this curve, since the points double.

Consumer: manabot's MTG-183 report (experiment mtg183-elemental-eval, an evaluation-only experiment whose seats declare at={'updates': N} and a line). Its halving pairs are being played now on rented GPUs.
